source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-09 in three steps. Step 1, the table's own CA(33;3,121,2) (Power CT over GF(11), row S7) is doubled by the Roux construction with a 10-row strength-2 array on 121 columns (one zero row and 121 distinct 5-subsets of the other 9 rows), giving CA(43;3,242,2) (programs/roux242.py). Step 2, one free row is added and a SAT solver lists columns that can be appended once the new row may cover their missing triples (programs/ppool.py, 2868 columns in 300 s). Step 3, two listed columns whose demands on the new row agree and whose joint triples are covered are joined (programs/ppair.py, first pair found at once). Exact check with ca_verify, all 3-sets
construction: Roux doubling of the Power CT CA(33;3,121,2), then one row and two columns added by exact search
notes: ties the cited size 44 at k = 244; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start
